# FDG8085

> CONSIDER having the output of `ToString` be a valid input for any parsing methods on this type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.3 Object.ToString.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test suggestion
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether the output parses with the type's parsing methods is behavior.

## From the book

For example, the string returned from `DateTime.ToString` can be successfully parsed using `DateTime.Parse`.

```csharp
DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
DateTime parsed = DateTime.Parse(now.ToString());
```
